$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026 via pdftotext (paginated, page-by-page) from '2027 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATIONS/&Beyond/andBeyond Lodge Rates 2027 - Kenya STO20 - FB.pdf'. Single document covers THREE &Beyond Kenya properties (Suyian Lodge, Bateleur Camp, Kichwa Tembo Tented Camp) - all extracted. NOT a Soroi property. A companion 'Tanzania STO20' PDF also exists in the same folder but is out of scope for this Kenya slice.

source.file: 2027 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATIONS/&Beyond/andBeyond Lodge Rates 2027 - Kenya STO20 - FB.pdf
source.note: Rate sheet explicitly states: for travel 01-10 Jan 2027, refer to the 2026 rate sheet instead - this document's rates do not cover that window.

tier: RACK and STO (20% off rack, 1-3 nights); deeper 'STO Long Stay' discounts apply at 4-5 nights and 6+ nights - see discountLadder
unit: per person per night sharing, except Family Suite/Family Tent which is per unit per night
confidence: confirmed-2027-08-06 for RACK/STO figures actually printed; ancillary columns (Private Vehicle, Local Pilot/Driver-Guide, Tour Leader) captured but not cross-verified against source layout beyond a single read - flagged individually

discountLadder.note: Verified arithmetically: STO 1-3 nights = Rack x 0.80 exactly on every checked cell. 4-5 night and 6+ night figures are deeper than a flat 20% (long-stay discount), e.g. Suyian Suites High Season: Rack 2575 -> 1-3n 2060 (20% off) -> 4-5n 1957 (~24% off) -> 6+n 1751 (~32% off).

fullyInclusive.note: FULLY INCLUSIVE basis. Rate includes accommodation, all meals, soft drinks, alcoholic beverages (house pours, exclusions vary by lodge), tea/coffee, safari activities, laundry, medical evacuation cover, and lodge-specific airstrip transfers. Excludes park fees.

fullBoard.note: FULL BOARD basis (Bateleur Camp and Kichwa Tembo only - Suyian Lodge has no Full Board tier on this document, Fully Inclusive only). Excludes safari activities, night game drives, transfers, alcoholic house-pour scope narrower than Fully Inclusive - see source for exact wording.

mandatoryFees.unit: per person per night unless noted

kichwaTemboAndBateleurParkFee.note: Rate doubles for the Jul-Dec 2027 window vs Jan-Jun 2027 / early Jan 2028 window. Must be paid directly by guest if transferred by road/self-drive.

childPolicy.note: &Beyond's own portfolio policy - does NOT match Soroi's 5-11/12-17 brackets. Ages here are 0-2, 3-5, 6-16, 17+.
childPolicy.age0to2SharingWithAdults: Free of charge (cot, up to 18 months only)
childPolicy.notApplicableTo: Family Suites / Family Cottages / Family Tents (no child discount on these units - priced per unit)

Suyian Lodge.maxOccupancy: 2 adults + 2 children (3rd child on request, additional cost)

Bateleur Camp.config: 1 Family Tent (2 tents linked by enclosed walkway)
Bateleur Camp.maxOccupancy: 2 adults + 2 children (3rd child on request, additional cost)

Kichwa Tembo Tented Camp.config: 3 Family Tents (2 Superior Tents linked by enclosed walkway)
Kichwa Tembo Tented Camp.maxOccupancy: 2 adults + 2 children (3rd child on request, additional cost)

singleSupplement.shoulderWindow: 11 Jan-31 May & 01 Nov-20 Dec '27: 50% supplement only from the 3rd single room per booking
singleSupplement.peakWindow: 01 Jun-31 Oct & 21 Dec-10 Jan '28: 50% supplement on ALL single rooms

tripleRooms.note: Suitable for max 2 adults + 1 child aged 16 or younger. Availability limited per lodge (Suyian: 1 room, Bateleur: 2 rooms, Kichwa Tembo Superior View: 1 room / Superior: 2 rooms).

ancillaryRates.note: Private Vehicle, Local Pilot/Driver-Guide, and Tour Leader rate columns were present on the source table but the pdftotext layout for this densely-merged table made per-season column alignment harder to guarantee at a glance. Values below were cross-read from both a -layout and a plain-stream extraction and agree, but treat with slightly lower confidence than the core accommodation rates above.

privateVehiclePerNight.confidenceNote: [Unverified] appears constant at $788/vehicle/night across all three lodges and both rate bases in every row checked, but not exhaustively checked on every single row.

tourLeaderRate.note: 1 x Tour Leader travels at no charge per group threshold shown per lodge/season; beyond that a per-person day rate applies (e.g. Suyian Mid Season 620, High Season 1030). Full ladder not fully reconstructed for every lodge/season - re-check source directly before quoting a TL rate.

offersNotExtracted.note: Page 3 lists several signature offers (Milestone Celebrations 20% off, Honeymoon 50% off one partner, Kichwa Tembo Stay4Pay3, Fly Me to the Mara, Fly Me around East Africa) - not priced/extracted as they are promotional T&Cs, not base rates.
